items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions George Du-vivier, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal anecdote, relationship description, or confirmation of meeting him.

ctx.x: Yeah because that's something I want to touch on in the course of our interview, to talk about the people who handled the business at some point. I think that's something that we should get on the record too, your feelings. Because it's a very important part of it. Like you say, writing a check because a lot of folks will be writing some checks that controls a lot of stuff that goes down.
So during that time, it wasn't fair that George Du-vivier, one of the finest bass players in the world...
